ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Cathedral Pass
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Ash'karr campaign content: the Rust Cathedral's mechanoid pass (CATHEDRAL_MECHANOID_PASS_VERBS_1, arc spec §3 "Mechanoid pass", scope ruled 2026-09-13 to the narrowest reading).
A clan pawn carrying the RUT_CathedralPass flag is read as non-hostile by the mechanoid faction (faction 13, the Forgotten Arsenal) — but only on a Rust Cathedral map (RM_RustCathedral or RUT_RustCathedral). Other mechanoid factions are not covered, and off Cathedral ground the pass does nothing. One scoped Harmony postfix on GenHostility.HostileTo(Thing, Thing) carries the whole mechanism.
This build ships the GRANT flag and the hostility exception only. The GM-layer verbs that decide WHEN the Cathedral grants or revokes the pass (stage VOUCHED+, priced against Imperial Heat, revoked on demotion) belong to the Regard blackboard and are not built here; until then the pass is granted and revoked through the dev-mode debug actions or the public CathedralPass.Grant/Revoke API.
Mod Settings: one kill switch — off, the pass has no effect anywhere.
